name: V etom dome net muzhchin
source:
When a widow dies a painful death, she becomes an evil spirit. The ghost wanders around the village, breaks into locked houses, and kills the men who live inside. Does that sound like a creepy fairy tale?

It's a folk belief that runs throughout Southeast Asia. Every year in Thailand, dozens of men die in their beds at night under unusual circumstances: they fall asleep, never to wake up again. Many Thai people think these strange deaths are caused by Phi Maemai, the "widow ghost," who can ravage entire villages.

The "No men in this house" visual novel is based on the Phi Maemai legend. It tells the story of several eccentric tourists trapped on an island in Thailand because of a pandemic. When one of the villagers mysteriously dies, the characters begin an investigation and conclude that the death may have been caused by... a ghost?

Has the legend come to life, or are the creatures of flesh and blood at fault? Could it have been a tragic accident? "No men in this house" is an absurdist detective full of bizarre situations, erratic characters, biting humor, and a story about mysterious deaths on a Thai island that will make you suspect everyone, including yourself!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当寡妇痛苦地死去时，她就变成了邪灵。鬼魂在村庄里游荡，闯入上锁的房屋，杀死了住在里面的人。这听起来像一个令人毛骨悚然的童话故事吗？

这是整个东南亚的民间信仰。在泰国，每年都有数十名男子在不寻常的情况下在晚上死在床上：他们睡着了，再也没有醒来。许多泰国人认为这些奇怪的死亡事件是由“寡妇鬼”Phi Maemai造成的，它可以破坏整个村庄。

《这所房子里没有男人》视觉小说是根据Phi Maemai传说改编的。该剧讲述了几位性格古怪的游客因疫情被困在泰国一座小岛上的故事。当一名村民神秘死亡时，角色们开始调查并得出结论，死亡可能是由……鬼魂造成的？

到底是传说成真了，还是血肉之物的错？这会是一场悲惨的事故吗？《这所房子里没有男人》是一个荒诞派侦探，充满了离奇的情况、古怪的人物、辛辣的幽默，以及一个关于泰国岛上神秘死亡的故事，这会让你怀疑所有人，包括你自己！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099030/]Steam[/url]]
